hbs.title: State-wise Average Number of Cold Wave Days

meta.coverage: State-wise Average Number of Cold Wave Days: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 103
meta.note: DBIE report 1730, data provider "Query 1". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: calendar years. Dimensions: none; measures: value. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
